(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Northrop Grumman is a space-focused company serving government, civil, and commercial customers. The Associate Software Engineer will join the Software and Controls Engineering team to design, develop, document, test, and debug software and may collaborate on multidisciplinary research and electronic data processing systems.
Associate Software Engineer designing, developing, testing, and debugging applications software and systems with logical and mathematical solutions

Responsibilities:
• In this job, you can expect to design, develop, document, test and debug applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions. You may also conduct multidisciplinary research and collaborate with equipment designers and/or hardware engineers in the planning, design, development, and utilization of electronic data processing systems for product and commercial software

Requirements:
• Be completing or has completed their degree (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD) from an accredited institution
• Be majoring in or having majored in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related STEM field
• Be able to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)
• The ability to obtain Special Access Program within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs

Preferred:
• Have an overall cumulative GPA of 3.00/4.0 or higher
